question: U9: the Layers list's icons beyond Shape, Text and Button. Sixteen types in two sets of eight (A: Image, Line, Video, Code, Form, Map, Quote, Accordion; B: Newsletter, Scrolling, Chart, Embed, Markdown, Social Links, Menu, Calendar), each set added to a new blank section; the section's Layers opened and every icon in its panel read (svgSigs: box, the row's words, colours, what it is drawn with, a hash of its markup, the markup not kept). Then Add Block's menu opened on a blank section, nothing pressed in it, and its tile icons read the same way, to tell whether a row's icon is its tile's. Two runs. Nothing pressed inside any block.
